answer: Recursive vouching liability chains bind every new account to an existing sponsor who co-signs an escrowed surety bond before the recruit can earn weight. If an audited descendant commits fraud or fails a liveness pulse, slashing propagates upstream through the endorsement prism, burning a geometric share of each ancestor's locked collateral. Because a single compromised voucher sees its entire downstream island liquidated simultaneously, honest veterans underwrite only scarce, vetted operators while Sybil farms bankrupt their own root capital on first detection.
